text:
Predicates:
GiveOut(x, y) ::: x is given out on y.
TVShow(x) ::: x is a TV show.
On(x, y) ::: x is on y.
Portray(x, y) ::: x portrays y.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
RealPeople(x) ::: x are real people.
Premises:
∃x (Monday(x) ∧ Time8pm(x) ∧ GiveOut(roses, x) ∧ TVShow(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GiveOut(roses, x) → On(x, bachelor)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (On(x, bachelor) → Portray(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portray(x, realPeople) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
GiveOut(roses, breakingBad) → ∃x (Monday(x) ∧ Time8pm(x) ∧ On(breakingBad, x)) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
